messages.subject: Different estimates in mirt
parts:
I'm puzzled.  I ran analyses using mirt. I called (see attached screen shots) 

IRT_parms <- coef (model2, IRTpars = TRUE, simplify = TRUE

IRT_parms$items

This provided the slope parameter and the two location parameters for each item q14 through q112 (q001 is a gender item).  

Subsequently, I called 

coef( model2, IRTpars = TRUE, printSE = TRUE)

The above yielded a and b parameters and standard errors.  Notice that these estimates differ from the ones produced by the first code.  For example, q14 yields a slope parameter of 1.418 with the first code, but a slope parameter of 1.021 with the second code.  Item q29 yields a slope parameter of 0.618 with the first line of code, but a slope parameter of 0.484 with the second line of code.  

Additionally, the first code produces all of the scale items.  The second code omits the final item (q112).  I double-checked the items included in the analyses and they are correct.
